name: Navianos de Valverde (Spain)
description: Green field with a white triangle at the hoist bearing a dark blue wavy stripe.
history: The flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a green cloth with a white triangle bearing a blue wavy stripe, its vertices at the ends of the hoist and at the centre of the flag.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
